items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: I don't know that Red Allen being one band and Kid Red back there and the other one. That's a good band.

ctx.x: Guy Kellen, them boys was out there. It doesn't put hot. Yeah, you know how Red Allen's question.
The street was on fire. I don't know that Red Allen being one band and Kid Red back there and the other one. That's a good band. Rough band, man.
I wonder about the Excelsior band in particular, since everything they, you said they practiced so much and arranged things, that they'd play those numbers too.
